correctness.rationale: Every proper three-coloring decomposes uniquely into a proper four-spine coloring and independent leaf choices. In the swap difference, the D0=D2 identity and the L0L1(L1-L0)=L1L2(L2-L1) identity cancel all three summands for every h. Both caterpillars have bipartition sizes h+4 and 2h+5, so their used-color-two components agree; the three-used-color components then agree. For four colors, the [q^8] difference equals 14 at h=0, 4 at h=1, and 2 for 2<=h<=16 by exact direct spine-sum calculations. For h>=8, any spine color zero among the first three blocks forces exponent>8, and otherwise the degree-eight coefficient is a polynomial of degree<=8 in h. Values at 8..16 all equal two, proving the entire unbounded range. Reversal is excluded for every h. The included Python verifier exactly replays the finite certificates and direct small graph checks. Independent audit not performed.
